_comment: Per-rule ceiling for `ruff --select F` over app/, enforced by
scripts/check_ruff_gate.py in deploy.yml. A count may FALL, never rise.
Fix findings and ratchet the number down in the same change; do not raise a
number to make a build pass. Same contract as the platform repo's
.github/edge-typecheck-baseline.json.
NOT listed here, because they are enforced at ZERO by ZERO_TOLERANCE in the
gate script:
F821 undefined name        41 -> 0.  Covered a search path that never
searched, six pipeline endpoints that always
500'd, and four modules using an unimported module.
F811 redefinition          10 -> 0.  Three of the ten were live bugs: an
exception class declared twice so the registered
handler matched a different class than the one
raised; a decorator shadowed by an instance of the
same name; a service getter both imported and
redefined, resolved by line number.
invalid-syntax             A file ruff cannot parse is unchecked AND looks
clean, which is worse than any finding.
The rules below are hygiene debt, not broken code: unused imports (F401),
f-strings with no placeholders (F541), unused locals (F841), star-import
fallout (F403/F405). Worth grinding down, but none of them is a bug on its own.
